dialogues.speaker: Nanaxa
dialogues.text: (A little Tatankasaurus is lying on the ground, looking very relaxed...)

dialogues.speaker: Nanaxa
dialogues.text: *sigh* I dreamed of mouth-watering mushrooms again. No matter how fast I chase them, they always run away... I so want to eat mushrooms...

dialogues.speaker: Nanaxa
dialogues.text: Nappa's always giving me cabbage... It's not that I don't like cabbage, it's just that I really want mushrooms too...
